notes.title: Little Monster Needs Your Vote!
notes.notes:
Little Monster is competing in the [b]DevGAMM Awards 2024[/b] and community voting has begun! Voting ends [b]October 27[/b] and winners will be announced [b]November 15[/b]!

[h3][url=https://form.fillout.com/t/hZWP7Kgy7Aus]Vote for Little Monster here![/url][/h3]

DevGAMM Awards is a prestigious competition for indie developers and small studios. With a prize pool of $100,000 in real cash and additional nominations and prizes from sponsors, it offers a remarkable opportunity for emerging talent. The awards feature a vast panel of judges from the gaming industry and the grand ceremony will be in Lisbon, Portugal on November 15.

Little Monster has also been nominated in the following categories:

[b]Excellence in Game Design, Excellence in Visual Art, Most Anticipated Game[/b]

As the developer of Little Monster it's an honor to even be nominated and I appreciate all the love and support for the game. This has truly been a passion project for me and I hope players have a fun experience while exploring the world and features in Little Monster.

If you want to test drive the game before voting the Steam demo is out now! Voting ends October 27 so [url=https://form.fillout.com/t/hZWP7Kgy7Aus]cast your vote soon[/url]! Winners will be announced [b]November 15[/b]!

As always, thank you for all your support! See you in the monster realm!
